facts: Greyhounds appear to be the most ancient dog breed. "Greyhound" comes from a mistake in translating the early German name Greishund, which means "old (or ancient) dog," not from the color gray.
In Roman times, mastiffs donned light armor and were sent after mounted knights.
The Labrador Retriever is the most popular breed, according to the American Kennel Club.
With love and a little patience, dogs can learn to walk backwards, salute and bow.
In ancient China, an emperor's last line of defense was a small Pekingese dog literally hidden up his sleeve.
